data.overview: A violent hurricane floods a coastal town and cuts its residents off from rescue. As seawater fills streets and buildings, hungry sharks move through the rising channels, turning every attempt to escape into a gamble.
data.tagline: The storm brought something with it.
data.title: Shark Tide
